candidate_reports.remark: Near Pactola north of the main storm core. Report and photo via social media. Time estimated based on radar.
Time estimated based on DOT webcam and radar.
Largest stones quarter size. Most stones nickel size and smaller. Brief burst of very strong winds estimated at 60 MPH. Time estimated based on radar.
Southern edge of storm. Brief burst of very strong winds estimated at 60 MPH. Also hail with largest stones quarter size. Most stones nickel size and smaller. Time estimated based on radar.
Winds estimated at 60 to 70 MPH. Not much hail. Time estimated based on radar.
Reported along the southern edge of the storm on Highway 75 via Spotter Network.
Relayed by trained spotter. Time estimated based on radar.
Mostly heavy rain with not much hail. Largest few stones were nickel size. Time estimated based on radar.
Hail covered the ground. Time estimated based on radar.
Viewed from Highway 73 north of Faith looking northwest into the storm.
Measured with a tape measure near the intersection of Chance Rd and Usta Rd. Report and photo received via social media. Time estimated based on radar.
Tornado with full condensed ground contact ongoing observed from Highway 73 looking northwest. Debris being lofted around the base of the tornado.
Possible RFD surge just crossed Highway 73. Time estimated based on report and radar.
